summon-swarm.name: Summon Swarm
summon-swarm.targets: One swarm of bats, rats, or spiders

sunbeam.name: Sunbeam
sunbeam.duration: 1 round/level or until all beams are exhausted
sunbeam.save: Reflex negates and Reflex half; see text

sympathy.name: Sympathy
sympathy.targets: One location (up to a 10-ft. cube/level) or one object

telekinesis.name: Telekinesis
telekinesis.duration: Concentration (up to 1 round/ level) or instantaneous; see text
telekinesis.save: Will negates (object) or None; see text

telekinetic-sphere.name: Telekinetic Sphere
telekinetic-sphere.targets: 1-ft.-diameter/level sphere, centered around creatures or objects

telepathic-bond.name: Telepathic Bond
telepathic-bond.targets: You plus one willing creature per three levels, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart

teleport.name: Teleport
teleport.targets: You and touched objects or other touched willing creatures

teleport-object.name: Teleport Object
teleport-object.targets: One touched object of up to 50 lb./level and 3 cu. ft./level

teleportation-circle.name: Teleportation Circle
teleportation-circle.targets: 5-ft.-radius circle that teleports those who activate it

transmute-metal-to-wood.name: Transmute Metal to Wood
transmute-metal-to-wood.targets: All metal objects within a 40-ft.-radius burst

transport-via-plants.name: Transport via Plants
transport-via-plants.targets: You and touched objects or other touched willing creatures

tree-stride.name: Tree Stride
tree-stride.duration: 1 hour/level or until expended; see text

undeath-to-death.name: Undeath to Death
undeath-to-death.targets: Several undead creatures within a 40-ft.-radius burst

unhallow.name: Unhallow
unhallow.targets: 40-ft. radius emanating from the touched point

unholy-aura.name: Unholy Aura
unholy-aura.targets: One creature/level in a 20-ft.-radius burst centered on you

veil.name: Veil
veil.targets: One or more creatures, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart

wail-of-the-banshee.name: Wail of the Banshee
wail-of-the-banshee.targets: One living creature/level within a 40-ft.-radius spread

wall-of-fire.name: Wall of Fire
wall-of-fire.targets: Opaque sheet of flame up to 20 ft. long/level or a ring of fire with a radius of up to 5 ft. per two levels; either form 20 ft. high

wall-of-force.name: Wall of Force
wall-of-force.targets: Wall whose area is up to one 10-ft. square/level

wall-of-ice.name: Wall of Ice
wall-of-ice.targets: Anchored plane of ice, up to one 10-ft. square/level, or hemisphere of ice with a radius of up to 3 ft. + 1 ft./level

wall-of-iron.name: Wall of Iron
wall-of-iron.targets: Iron wall whose area is up to one 5-ft. square/level; see text

wall-of-stone.name: Wall of Stone
wall-of-stone.targets: Stone wall whose area is up to one 5-ft. square/level (S)

wall-of-thorns.name: Wall of Thorns
wall-of-thorns.targets: Wall of thorny brush, up to one 10-ft. cube/level (S)

warp-wood.name: Warp Wood
warp-wood.targets: 1 Small wooden object/level, all within a 20-ft. radius

weird.name: Weird
weird.targets: Any number of creatures, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart

whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
whirlwind.targets: Cyclone 10 ft. wide at base, 30 ft. wide at top, and 30 ft. tall

whispering-wind.name: Whispering Wind
whispering-wind.duration: No more than 1 hour/level or until discharged (destination is reached)

wind-walk.name: Wind Walk
wind-walk.targets: You and one touched creature per three levels

wind-wall.name: Wind Wall
wind-wall.targets: Wall up to 10 ft./level long and 5 ft./level high (S)

wood-shape.name: Wood Shape
wood-shape.targets: One touched piece of wood no larger than 10 cu. ft. + 1 cu. ft./level

word-of-chaos.name: Word of Chaos
word-of-chaos.targets: Nonchaotic creatures in a 40-ft.- radius spread centered on you
word-of-chaos.save: None or Will negates; see text

word-of-recall.name: Word of Recall
word-of-recall.targets: You and touched objects or other willing creatures
